meta.note: City of Vancouver charges paid at building permit, per m2 of floor area. Regional charges (Metro Vancouver, TransLink) are not included: open data gap.
meta.residential_definition: Residential above 1.5 FSR (the rate that applies to a tower).

commercial.name: Commercial and most other uses
commercial.note: Hotel is placed here (pack author's reading, grade C).

below_market_inclusionary.name: Inclusionary below-market rental floor area
below_market_inclusionary.note: ACC exempt (bulletin). DCL treatment not confirmed: residential rates assumed.

social_housing.name: Social housing
social_housing.note: ACC exempt (bulletin). DCL treatment not confirmed: residential rates assumed; check the DCL by-law.

civic_flat.name: Childcare, library, community centre, cultural facility (incl. artist studios)
civic_flat.note: ACC is a flat C$10 per building permit. DCL treatment not confirmed: commercial rates assumed.

unknown.name: Not classified (parking, transit, core, reserved space)
unknown.note: Treatment not confirmed; commercial rates used as a cautious default. User should check.

dcl.name: Vancouver Development Cost Levy (after 20% temporary reduction)

escalation.note: ACC and DCL rise 3% a year through 2029. Pack author's reading (grade C): the DCL and Utilities DCL rates listed are taken as the 2026 rates and each ACC step as the rate in its own year; the tool adds 3% for each later year up to 2029.

rental_waivers.note: Only for 100% rental projects: 100% ACC waiver with 20%+ below-market; 86% waiver for 100% market rental. A tower with condos does not qualify.

cac.note: Negotiated Community Amenity Contribution for large, complex rezonings: share of land lift. Zero if the lift is negative or the rezoning is 100% employment.

share_of_lift.note: City historically took about 70-80% of the lift after a 15% developer profit.

gaps: Metro Vancouver and TransLink development cost charges (2026 rates not found).
DCL treatment of social housing, civic and parking floor area not confirmed.
